snippet.title: UFC 6 Official Game Modes Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Pre-order UFC® 6 Ultimate Edition to receive 7-day early access and the Iconic Moments Bundle: https://x.ea.com/89250 

UFC 6 Game Modes Blog: https://x.ea.com/89329

The game modes of UFC 6 let you deepen your connection to the fighters and the sport. Explore how in this UFC 6 deep dive.

In The Legacy, step into the shoes of Chris Carter, a collegiate wrestling prospect working his way through the regional scene with dreams of fighting under the bright lights.

If The Legacy gets the journey started, UFC Career Mode is where you take control and chase greatness on your terms. Continue Chris Carter’s story, start building a new UFC legacy with a Created Fighter, or as your favorite athlete.

Hall of Legends is an immersive experience that lets players explore the stories and environments that shaped the lives of UFC superstars. Relive their iconic fights in a never-before-experienced fashion, through a seamless mix of live fight footage, cinematic scenes, and gameplay.

1:28 Career Mode

4:21 The Gym
